definitions: A mollusc with a long, soft body, no shell, and two pairs of retractable tentacles, similar to a snail but typically living on land and often considered a pest.
An amount of an alcoholic drink, typically a strong one, swallowed in one gulp.
A small, usually metal, piece used as currency or for identification.
examples: The garden was full of slugs after the rain.
He loaded a slug into the shotgun.
She took a slug of whisky.
Don't be such a slug, get up and help!
The machine dispensed a slug for the game.
